description: Global Dam Tracker: A database of more than 35,000 dams with location, catchment, and attribute information is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Alice Tianbo Zhang, Gu, Vincent Xinyi (Washington and Lee University). Citation Zhang, Alice Tianbo, and Vincent Xinyi Gu. 2023. “Global Dam Tracker: A Database of More than 35,000 Dams with Location, Catchment, and Attribute Information.” Scientific Data 10 (1): 111. https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-023-02008-2 Description We present one of the most complete geo-referenced global dam databases to date. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
